display_family: Appears consistent with original Raspberry Pi 7-inch Touch Display; exact variant not yet confirmed
observed_assembly: Pi mounted directly behind display on existing standoffs; four outer threaded mounting lugs visible on metal display back; orange flex and DSI ribbon present

mount_design.load_path: Continuous recessed seat under rear glass perimeter stops inward movement without screws. Four screws into metal lugs retain against front withdrawal; four support arms integral with case.
mount_design.glass: Own black border visible in white recessed seat, supported from behind on 3 mm bearing width. No separate bezel or front overlap.
mount_design.service: Remove four rear M3 screws, unplug cables, extract display and attached Pi through the front; integral mounts stay in place
mount_design.spacers: Seat and rear lug lands must meet the freely seated display simultaneously. Correct lug gaps with measured rigid shims or revised pads; screws must not pull the glass across a gap. No gasket assumed.
mount_design.wiring: Keep ribbon bends, GPIO jumpers, USB/Ethernet plugs, SD access and airflow clear
mount_design.lightweight: Thin front skin with local reinforcement; replace old full-depth side ribs and generic box retainer; remove separate Pi wall mounts only when revised complete assembly clearances are checked
mount_design.glass_outline_reference: V49 retains V48 opening 193.6 x111.4 mm, R8.2; revised depth and screw grip passed corner tests.

mount_design.raised_band_relief: Not needed: user explicitly confirms band stays inside central area and clears outermost 3 mm bearing strip.
mount_design.seat_bearing_width_note: 3 mm inward from glass perimeter; integral rigid support width, not padding thickness. Full width has 2.3 mm material thickness.
